summary.text: J.R. Henson is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 19, which covers parts of Fairfax and Prince William counties.
J.R. Henson has been a member since January 10, 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, J.R. Henson was born in Woodbridge, Virginia.
J.R. Henson studied at Virginia State University (B.A., Political Science, 2016) and the University of Maryland, University College (MBA, 2019).
J.R. Henson's listed occupation is program management and small business owner.
J.R. Henson's listed memberships and affiliations include the Prince William County Historical Commission.

The House profile lists J.R. Henson's committee assignments as Privileges and Elections, Communications, Technology and Innovation, and Health and Human Services, and J.R. Henson chairs the Campaigns and Candidates subcommittee of Privileges and Elections.
